description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Leila], [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Water/Poison.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Leila
description.text: Water/Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water/Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
